summary: Funnel-step trigger integration is correct and idiomatic. Tag/field triggers fire after the idempotency guard + audit write (no-op writes do not fire); EMIT_EVENT returns CONTINUE and dispatches at child depth; depth is an explicit int parameter (no ThreadLocal), 0 from manual controllers and enrollDepth+1 from StepExecutor. Cross-file signatures all align (5-arg dispatchForSubscriber, 4-arg addTag, 5-arg recordCustomFieldsSet). No backstop/Redis logic added in SubscriberServiceImpl or StepExecutor. No PII in new logs (no new log lines added in the hot paths; eventName is the matchKey, never logged).

findings.finding: Task 5 introduces a real 2-node bean cycle SubscriberServiceImpl <-> FunnelEventService (FunnelEventService injects SubscriberService for findById; now SubscriberServiceImpl injects FunnelEventService). Resolved with @Lazy on the constructor param. This is a separate edge from the StepExecutor->FunnelEventService edge the task discusses (which the Task-4 factory structurally breaks). @Lazy is the idiomatic break here and is NOT the prohibited StepExecutor workaround; a clear comment documents the distinction. Context-load is proven by SubscriberServiceImplIT + SubscriberTagAssignmentIT booting the full graph with both injections present (no BeanCurrentlyInCreationException).

Trigger-type literals exposed as public constants on FunnelEventService that mirror the package-private FunnelService.TRIGGER_* (same module). This avoids re-typing magic strings cross-package without widening FunnelService (owned by another task). Single source of truth preserved (the public constants reference the FunnelService ones).

verified: dispatchForSubscriber called with exact Task-4 signature (projectId, subscriberId, triggerType, matchKey, originDepth) at all 3 new call sites
addTag/recordCustomFieldsSet signature change + every call-site updated atomically (controllers->0, StepExecutor->enrollDepth+1, tests)
tag_added / custom_field_set fire AFTER writeSubscriberEvent; idempotent no-op branches return before firing
custom_field_set dispatched once per changed key (loop over changedKeys)
EMIT_EVENT returns StepResult.cont() with no added try/catch (dispatcher owns isolation)
no rate-limit/depth-cap/fan-out/Redis logic added outside FunnelEventService
